verdict.rationale: Docs list built-in local commands (cat, grep, wc, cd, ls, touch, cp, rm, ln, mv, mkdir, rmdir, df, du) and curl, scp, sftp are confirmed by GitHub as included, but tar is not mentioned anywhere and grep/cat/ls/curl support is confirmed while tar's presence is unverified. missing for 10: explicit confirmation of tar support, independent hands-on testing of these commands, and documentation of any limitations vs full POSIX utilities.
